conditions.displayName: Any 5xx response from a Phase 2 financial callable service (one incident per service)

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=one_of("createvariation","updatevariationdraft","approvevariation","applyvariationcommitment","progressclaimoperation","supplierinvoiceoperation","suppliersettlementoperation","postclientrefund","voidclientrefund","postclientreceiptapplication","voidclientreceiptapplication","voidclientinvoice","contractvalueoperation","estimateoperation","postclientcreditnote","voidclientcreditnote","postclientretentionrelease","voidclientretentionrelease","postclientreceipt","voidclientreceipt","transferboqtobudget") AND resource.labels.location="australia-southeast1" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx"

documentation.subject: A Phase 2 financial callable returned a server error
documentation.content:
## What this means

One of the Phase 2 financial callables (or a Phase 1 client-finance callable or `transferBoqToBudget`, redeployed with them) answered at least one request with an HTTP 5xx. The service is named in the incident. `approveFinalAccount` has its own policy (L3) and is not counted here.

Refusals that carry a code are 4xx and are NOT counted, with ONE exception: a global switch that is OFF answers `…-disabled` with **HTTP 503** (gRPC `unavailable`). This policy is created only after the switches are on (Stage F); while a brake is pulled on purpose, expect 503s from the braked services.

**Effect on data:** every operation is one transaction (a baseline: fenced chunks and one completion). A failed call wrote nothing, or wrote the whole operation and lost only the reply. The user is told the outcome is uncertain and to reload.

## Read the log first

Logs Explorer (read only):

`resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="<service from the incident>" AND (severity>=ERROR OR httpRequest.status>=500)`

| What you find | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `Error: <family> call failed` with a `stack` field | Untyped exception in the handler (HTTP 500). The error text is in `jsonPayload.stack`; the logger overwrites the entry's own `message`. | Read the stack. Check the document (next section). Report it as a defect. |
| Status 503 and a `<family> call refused` line with a `…-disabled` code | A switch is off. | Expected while a brake is pulled. Otherwise check the served revision's parameters. |
| Status 503/500 with no handler line, or `Memory limit of … exceeded` in `run.googleapis.com/varlog/system` | The container failed, was killed or could not start. | `gcloud run services describe <service> --region australia-southeast1 --project constrapp-69b5d` (read only): latest revision Ready, 100% traffic. |
| Status 504, or a request of about the function's timeout | Timeout (`DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`). | Check record volume (a first baseline reads whole registers) and Firestore status. Do not raise the limit without approval. |
| `4 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`, `14 UNAVAILABLE` or `8 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` in a stack | Firestore transport failure. | One is transient. Repeats raise the deadline policy. |

## Was anything written?

Ask the user to reload the register. The document is either unchanged (nothing written; they may retry: every operation is idempotent by state or by client-chosen id) or changed with one audit event (the call committed; only the reply was lost). Never edit a financial document, a ledger or a baseline marker in the console.

## Escalate

Repeated failures on one project, or any sign of a partly written operation, go to the Product Owner and the Lead Architect before anyone retries. Brake: set the family's switch to false and redeploy those functions, or deactivate the company with the operator tool. A brake stops new operations; it reverses nothing.

Never paste a log entry, an amount, a customer name or a token into a ticket or chat: give the service, the time, the project and document ids, and the code.

Runbook: `ops/monitoring/phase2/README.md`. Cutover and recovery: `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`, section *Phase 2 — the complete cutover*.
